answer: The relic escrow is released only against a knoll receipt, and the vine audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 10 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 78 aliases means carrying 173 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 10 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
